name: convention-test-file-properties
description: A file an applied convention row's test-file property names is a test file, so its top level and the functions it exports are roots of the test run and what only it and the tests reference is test-support code: the vitest row's setupFiles and globalSetup each name one. A helper only such a file and a test reference is test code that the test reference keeps live, and neither the global setup's exported hook nor the members its augmentation of the runner's module declares for the tests to read is reported.
